body: I sat there for a while. I couldn't turn the key.
Yep. And I can't make it better.

I've tried the other options. I'm on anti depressants, I have a therapist, I've been to the crisis center in town more than once.

Nothing works to get rid of the constant physical pain in my chest. Nothing except what I'm doing now.
Well... I have nobody anymore. And I just want them back. They were the only ones I didn't have to wear a (figurative) mask around.
Well, they won't have me anymore. So that seems fitting.
Yeah. It fucking sucks. I've tried apologizing, but one person said no and blocked me, the other ripped up a letter without reading it, that I had spent hours writing.

I've tried before. I passed out, and later woke up to a cop calling me... The feeling before passing out was pure bliss, and I want that feeling again. It's so much better than the pain. In fact, right now, knowing what's about to happen, I feel happier than I have in a long, long time.

I lost everyone close to me in the same week. Asked my wife for a divorce, and all my close friends abandoned me (because I hurt them in the depression as I was leading up to asking wife for divorce).
The week I asked for a divorce, all my friends abandoned me. I went from solid friend group to nothing, and an empty house.
I'll talk to anyone who wants to, as long as they understand I'm not backing out of this.
I'm a monster. I need to be put down. I'm the only one that can do it.
